sections.title: Unit 3: Epistemic Hedging, Probability & Evidential Stance
body: In scholarly research and analytical writing, absolute assertions are rare. Intellectual maturity requires precise calibration of certainty, skepticism, and evidentiary source.

In this unit, inspired by Antal Szerb's ironic and scholarly essays, you will master epistemic modality (aligha feltételezhető, minden bizonnyal, úgy hírlik), evidentiality markers, and the art of academic hedging.
